meta_description:
2,138 likes, 89 comments - anoushkalila on October 9, 2026: "Comment “GUIDE” to get my free Český Krumlov guide straight to your inbox, with all my top tips for sightseeing, spectacular views, and the best dining 👇🏼

Considering we only had a day in Český Krumlov, we managed to take so many pictures that I’m probably going to be bombarding you for years to come. But when it looks like this, can you blame me?

I expected this beautiful Czech fairytale town to be picturesque, but I didn’t expect there to be quite so much to do. The town has a thriving arts and culture scene, and centuries of rich history. So yes, there’s truly breathtaking vistas. But there’s also so much beneath the surface.

My Český Krumlov cheat sheet:

- Visit the Castle Museum and Tower, Egon Schiele Art Centrum (we fell in love with the beautiful work of Lois Fasching on display here), Monastery Museum and Museum Fotoatelier Seidel
- Brunch at Bistro Topinka, dinner at Krčma Šatlava
- Grab a cocktail at Apotheka after a day of exploring
- Head to the viewpoints in and around the tower complex for sunset
- 30 minutes outside Český Krumlov Hluboká Castle makes a great half day trip

Lots more tips on where to stay and what to do over on the blog - I so hope it’s helpful. My outfit is also fully shoppable - link in bio!
